children: Reference is made to the announcement by Bruton limited (the “Company”) dated 16 October 2026 regarding an agreement to merge with International Seaways, Inc.

Jens Martin Jensen, a director of Bruton Limited, have entered into an agreement to exchange his shares of the Company with shares of International Seaways, Inc., at the agreed exchange rate of 0.0519 shares in International Seaways per share in the Company. Following the exchange Jens Martin Jensen will hold no shares in the Company.
This information is disclosed as required by Regulation EU596/2014 ("MAR"), article 19 and section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.
